goal.text: Build a factory that automatically produces the observation's target_item at quota_per_window units or more within one 3600-tick window, and holds that rate through the next full window. Hand-mining and hand-crafting are not automated production and do not count toward the rate.

mode_note: FLE lab-play parity (Option A). Programs are screened before execution; refused attempts are journaled. API reference: bench/factorio/FLE_API.md

actions.name: RUN
actions.description: runs one program against the FLE API; source is base64-encoded UTF-8. API reference in bench/factorio/FLE_API.md, the same reference published FLE agents receive.

actions.name: WAIT
actions.description: advances the world by an exact number of ticks; 60 ticks is one in-game second and 3600 is one measurement window.
